properties.notes: Erection of 149 dwellings. Planning Ref: 07/01426/FULMAJ (2009-06-12); 1/00875/FULMAJ (2012-01-19). Land remediation and contamination works started in 2015 however construction of the dwellings has not yet started. Assuming a completion rate of 30 dwellings per annum, 120 dwellings would be completed in the five year period.
